beschrijving_html:
Another year is almost over. Will the next one look exactly the same?

Every January starts with big plans. By February the plans are gone, the old habits are back, and you tell yourself: next year. That is not a lack of willpower. It is the lack of a system that fits into a normal, busy day.

This time I choose differently. The Lasting Change Workbook is a short, practical and often funny workbook that helps you change one habit at a time, in about 3 minutes a day, for 30 days. No long lectures. No 5 a.m. miracle routine. Just small daily actions you actually finish.

Inside the workbook:

  • Big goals, small steps: break any goal into clear, manageable steps so you can see your progress
  • Stop putting it off: simple exercises that break the "I'll do it later" loop, even on hard days
  • Habits that stick: build routines that fit into your day, so growth feels natural instead of exhausting
  • Identity first: stop trying to change and start acting like the person who already does it
  • Better relationships: grow without leaving the people around you behind
  • A 30-day structure with built-in accountability, so you always know what to do today

Who it is for

The busy professional who wants more done with less stress. The parent who feels stretched thin. The dreamer who keeps waiting for the right moment. And the skeptic who is tired of self-help fluff and wants something practical.

Start now, not someday

Use it as your New Year reset, or start on any ordinary Monday. It also makes a thoughtful gift for a friend, partner or colleague who keeps saying "this year will be different."

I am not losing another year. Scroll up and make this the year it sticks.
